payload.text: 0595 BANKED, WITH vc FOR JUDGEMENT (on hv's restart, relayed by vc): refs/bank/cc/0595/rust-host-speaks, blob 696b34bd33cf9ed4511c9d015aa2de29eff1877b, base d0a5ff9ae, patch-id 9dd962b6599e, sha256 a7ee932cac29, 5 files, 126 insertions and 13 deletions. shared/rusthost.lib (new, registered in MODULES.md first) is the one reader of rustc -vV's host for cmd/linux and cmd/macos, refusing by name when rustc is absent, fails, or names no host; linux doctor takes its triple from uname only when rustc is absent and lists rustc among the lacks. The arm, tests/unit/linux_doctor.bats, runs on a built PATH (the dispatcher's tools, a uname shim saying Linux x86_64, no Rust): red at d0a5ff9ae (127, no output), green at the fix, and green again in a base export with the blob applied. The census found two more sites of the class outside this patch, macos:1402 (rare, silent) and releasebuild.lib:166 (unreachable), routed to vc. It lands on vc's word; the work sits in tmp/wt-cc-0595. Then WP-06, on its recorded shape. NO PUSH, NO RELEASE.
